name: Labor Temporary Residence (RT-3) / Work Visa (NM1)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a notarized employment contract (fixed 1-year or indefinite) with a Dominican employer, plus Ministry of Labour certification of the company and a work proposal from the employer.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a qualifying job offer from a registered Dominican employer.

requirements.blocker_text: A Multiple Business/Work Visa (NM1) must be obtained at a Dominican consulate before entry, valid 1 year with multiple entries.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for the NM1 visa at a Dominican consulate.

requirements.blocker_text: Passport must be valid for at least six months.

evidence_required.document: Ministry of Labour certification of employer
Criminal record certificate from country of origin/residence
Medical exam from a DGM-authorized institution

sources.title: Dirección General de Migración -- Labor Temporary Residence (RT-3): employment contract, Ministry of Labour certification, 1-year validity, fees, no ID card issued for this category
MIREX Portal Único de Servicios de Relaciones Exteriores -- Work Visa (NM1): 1-year, multiple entries, Labour Ministry work proposal, company certification

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Dominican Republic). pr_after_months (60) and citizenship_after_months (84) are inferred, not route-specific: DGM's Permanent Residence (RP-1) page requires 'the first card plus 4 temporary residence renewals' before applying (read as ~5 years of continuous temporary residence, since each renewal is annual), and Ordinary Naturalization then requires a further 2 years as a Permanent Resident per both DGM's current page and the 1948 Naturalization Law (Ley 1683) -- see do_permanent_residence.json and do_naturalisation.json for the sourcing on each leg. This chained estimate is flagged as an inference, not a figure stated anywhere as a single number. DGM explicitly notes 'a Personal Identity Card is not issued' for RT-3 holders -- a real practical limitation worth surfacing, since most other residence categories in this dataset do issue one.
